display_name: 只依赖输入信号的干净保护与直接恢复
description: 训练独立盲信道受损识别网络保护干净波形，筛选固定识别指导直接 IQ 恢复候选；源域新记录选模，冻结后 Phase1 评估。

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256]; source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated post_sync residual channel
data.tx_sets_ref: Six Phase1 TX; detector training uses corruption scene labels only, no TX labels

permissions.query_use: No target data until all source selection fixed; then seven-view predictions before truth; no Phase3
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed, source heldout and Phase1 development previously observed, no independent-blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: New blind IQ corruption detector; fixed direct semantic source checkpoints 1/3/5; ground SSL frozen; no DURA
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: core.data checks physical IDs against Tri-SIG-TIME roles; parent commit exact
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fresh RX4/6 day3 source F pseudo agreement and IQ, 3 parent checkpoints x alpha .25/.5 x gate thresholds .8/.9/.95/.99; <=0.5% cell accuracy loss, clean IQ <=.001, impaired IQ <=1.1x raw+1e-6, net gain >=10; retain raw if no candidate; RX8 heldout not used in selection

dimensions: source per receiver and scene F pseudo agreement
source clean preservation and gate rate
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Goal six scenario accuracies versus clean ground SSL <=3 pp and also <=3% relative, clean protection, no blind claim.

rows.method: blind input-only temporal-spectral corruption detector gating fixed direct IQ semantic-restorer outputs, no DURA dependency
rows.purpose: source-selected clean protection then Phase1 test
rows.seed_notes: source exact role split fixed 2026110551, gate initialization and phase augmentation 2026111054, source ordering 2026111055
rows.scenario: source clean + six simulated scenarios, followed by seven full Phase1 views if selected

notes: Source IQ and simulated clean/impaired scene labels train gate; no TX labels, V, target IQ or DURA read during training.
Frozen clean F outputs only for source selection, F parameters never trained.
Gate design responds to previously observed source clean-guard failure; new validation IDs disjoint from prior 4096 but historical F and models saw source IDs.
Fixed Phase1 development set is nonblind.
